Under original SERVER, reject handler transaction_active and active original SQLite/DuckDB connection.in_transaction; decline unsupported adapters. Recheck after replay. No BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK or SQL writes; retain bounded lock acquisition.

Detach _payload; retain original gateway/server/lock/connection/service/store/CAS objects, owner/source binding bytes, generation/fence/task revision/body, request/limits/paths/bounds and grant/peer/session/request identities. Reuse _assert_current_source_binding and _authorize_source_grant.

Release SERVER for retained _load only; keep SQL/native connection use under SERVER. CAS callbacks may enter coordinator fences outside SERVER. Check original reader/config/store before and after replay; no replacement owner/client/CAS.

Reacquire original SERVER; reject changed retained identities, bindings, live grant/session or transaction state. Join inventory/selected source to admitted bytes, complete committed population and exact working bytes/mode. Close native/task/source/grant checks after supported CAS/clock callbacks, with no subsequent CAS replay.

Stage response/cursors privately; final grant/expiry, generation/task body, full-source and selected-file checks precede predecessor consumption, successor publication and reply. Serialize registry mutation under original SERVER; reject stale/substituted state. Publication must follow gateway closing authorization.
